sections.name: Pointer Aliasing Rules
sections.observed: Memory accesses require association with their whole accessed address range; GEP and bitcast retain based-on relation

sections.name: getelementptr semantics
sections.observed: inbounds constrains arithmetic and actual allocated object extent; violations produce poison, one-past GEP alone is allowed

sections.name: freeze semantics
sections.observed: Frozen undef/poison pointers are non-dereferenceable; cannot be used as precise legitimate source

sections.name: Pointer capture
sections.observed: Any stored bits carrying pointer information, integer transport, return or cross-thread publication can constitute capture
